items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: we did one thing, one tune we did, transbluency... it was just like a duet

ctx.x: That album you did, is that Wafers in

I think so, yes, yes. But you know, she's a very astute young lady. I -- we did one thing, one tune we did, transbluency. Now, this was done by Duke and Kay Davis. No lyrics, just voice and horns. So I -- it came off so well, Maria -- Marie -- Benny Carter was playing the horn, you know, so it was just like a duet. And I -- and of course Benny arranged it for her. And I said, Benny, that was a marvelous idea you had for Maria Muldaur. He said, no, John, she heard this record and had the idea and approached me…
